name: finance_bench-16384
description: A finance-focused text benchmark (with 16k context) designed to evaluate models on financial question answering and numerical reasoning using long-context documents. It measures the ability to retrieve, reason about, and summarize finance-related information across extended inputs. Targeted at assessing domain knowledge and long-range context handling in financial applications.
reputation: A community-contributed benchmark used by a small set of practitioners exploring long-context finance tasks; not broadly standardized.
